title: Fake KYC update / bank account block (synthetic)

turns.text: Good afternoon sir, I am calling from Greenfield Cooperative Bank KYC department. Your account will be blocked today because your KYC is not updated.
Your pension will stop and the card will be deactivated. We must complete the update in the next ten minutes.
To update KYC, install our support app first. Download it from https://kyc-update.example/greenfield-support.apk and open it.
Okay sir, open your UPI app and keep it ready for the payment.
The app is not opening? Then pay a one rupee verification to our KYC desk UPI ID kyc.desk@okaxis.
Yes kyc.desk@okaxis, K Y C dot desk at okaxis. Send one rupee now.
Sir hurry up, the system is closing your account.
The UPI is failing because your account is restricted. Transfer the amount to the KYC holding account instead.
Account number three three four four five five six six seven seven eight eight, IFSC Y E S B zero zero zero seven seven one.
That is 3344 5566 7788, YESB0000771. If there is a problem, call our helpdesk on eight eight double zero one two three four five six.
Sir, why are you so slow? Your account is being blocked.
